title: The summons of the Demon Path Commander echoes once more.
next_chapter_hook: Just as the gazes of three major powers fell upon Chen Ji simultaneously, beyond the Heavenly Realm's barrier, an even more ancient aura stirred quietly—the sealed ancient existence, peering through the cracks at all of this.

text.content: Golden runes rotated slowly within the depths of the Tianji Record, Mo Xiansheng's voice piercing through like from ancient primordial times. Chen Ji sat cross-legged in the meditation chamber, spiritual energy flowing around his body, yet his eyes snapped open the moment the runes appeared. In the depths of his pupils, a profound light flashed—the Tianji Record Fragment was resonating.

dialogue.content: "The time has come—you should see the true chessboard." Mo Xiansheng's voice was no longer fragmented, carrying an ancient majesty. "The Tianji Record is a tool from the dawn of heaven and earth; peeking into heavenly secrets is merely its surface. The true chessboard encompasses Heaven's Way, the Demonic Path, and humanity's Way."

text.content: Before the words even finished, the world beyond the meditation chamber suddenly changed. The originally clear sky was eroded by dense black mist, within which blood-red lightning arcs intertwined, like the claw marks of ancient fierce beasts tearing through the barrier. The air was filled with decay and death, yet carried an unsettling sense of familiarity.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's expression shifted slightly, yet he immediately steadied his mind. He didn't cry out or panic; instead, he swiftly activated the Tianji Record Fragment, capturing the incoming aura within his consciousness. On the Fragment, blurry images began to emerge—the aura of the Demon Path Commander, crossing numerous barriers to arrive.

text.content: "Demon Path Commander..." Chen Ji murmured softly, a hint of amusement flickering across his brow. He naturally remembered Ye Qing, that Demon Path Saintess controlled and utilized by the Holy Sect. Now the Holy Sect churned with undercurrents, and the Demon Path forces were formally intervening in Heavenly Realm's landscape—this game grew ever larger and more intriguing.

dialogue.content: Just then, a massive will descended from the depths of the heavens, piercing directly through the meditation chamber's barrier and exploding in Chen Ji's mind: "Chen Ji, this One knows you have obtained the Tianji Record Fragment. This is a heaven-sent opportunity—will you submit to my Demonic Path?" The voice was ancient and majestic, filled with irresistible oppression.

text.content: Chen Ji sensed the power contained within that will, his heart subtly tightening. The Demon Path Commander's aura was more ancient, more profound than Cang Yutian, like a deep-sea monster that had lain dormant for millennia. Yet his face showed no fear; instead, his lips curved slightly upward into a meaningful smile.

dialogue.content: "The Demon Path Commander personally arrives—how could Chen Ji deserve such honor." He rose, his robes moving without wind, his voice clear. "I only wonder if this summons values Chen Ji's Tianji Record Fragment, or Chen Ji as a chess piece?" The words carried hidden sharpness, both revealing awareness of the other's intentions while maintaining propriety.

text.content: The Tianji Record Fragment trembled within Chen Ji, and those blurry images became somewhat clearer. He saw that within the Demonic Path, unity was not solid—there was a faction actively competing with Cang Yutian, even secretly connecting with Heavenly Realm's local forces. And this Demon Path Commander's summons was precisely the first olive branch they extended to Chen Ji.

choice.prompt: The Demon Path Commander's summons hung like a sword over his head, and Heavenly Realm's local forces expressed strong dissatisfaction with the Demonic Path's intervention. Now Chen Ji, facing this sudden change in circumstances, had to make a choice—

choices.description: Directly respond to the Demon Path Commander, demonstrate sincere willingness to cooperate, while also gathering more intelligence about the internal struggles within the Demonic Path.
choices.visible_cost: May provoke hostility from Heavenly Realm's local forces
choices.visible_reward: Gain initial recognition from the Demonic Path forces and unlock more information from the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Realm forces may view Chen Ji as a Demon Path lackey
choices.process_label: 陈机决定主动接触魔道势力

text.content: Chen Ji slightly nodded, his voice calm yet clear: "Since the Commander has sincerity, Chen Ji is willing to hear the details." His attitude was neither servile nor arrogant, showing willingness to engage in dialogue without hastily declaring allegiance.

A wave of satisfaction transmitted from that massive will: "Good. This One will send someone, and at that time will surely give you a satisfactory answer." The black mist began to recede slowly, yet that oppressive pressure still lingered above the meditation chamber.

choices.description: Clearly state refusal of the Demonic Path's recruitment, firmly stand with Heavenly Realm's local forces, while secretly observing the situation.
choices.visible_cost: May lose this intelligence source from the Demonic Path
choices.visible_reward: Consolidate position among Heavenly Realm's local forces and avoid being drawn into conflict prematurely
choices.risk_hint: The Demonic Path forces may view Chen Ji as a potential threat
choices.process_label: 陈机决定保持距离观察

text.content: Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, his gaze calmly fixed upon that black mist: "The Commander's generous favor, Chen Ji gratefully acknowledges. But as a disciple of the Tianqing Sect, Chen Ji dares not presumptuously speak of submission." His tone was gentle yet firm, clearly drawing a line.

A cold snort echoed from the black mist: "Tianqing Sect? A tiny Heavenly Realm sect dares to refuse this Lord's summons?" The imposing pressure in that thought suddenly intensified, pressing down on Chen Ji's shoulders like something tangible.

choices.text: Waiting to Sell at the Best Price
choices.description: Not making a clear statement, but adopting a wait-and-see attitude to test each party's bottom line, striving for maximum benefit.
choices.visible_reward: Maintaining maximum freedom of action, creating space for subsequent arrangements
choices.risk_hint: Requires extremely high rhetoric skills; a single misstep and one will bring trouble upon oneself
choices.process_label: 陈机决定两边观望待价而沽

text.content: Chen Ji smiled faintly, clasped his hands, and said: "Commander, you misunderstand. Chen Ji is merely a piece of waste material - how could there be any question of allegiance? It's just that in this chaotic world, Chen Ji also wishes to find a path to survival." His words carried hidden meaning, neither refusing nor accepting.

The thought remained silent for a moment, then a meaningful laugh rang out: "Interesting lad. This Lord remembers you." The black mist gradually dissipated, but that aura did not completely vanish, as if watching Chen Ji's every move from the shadows.

At the same time, the reaction from the native forces of the Heavenly Realm was equally intense. Several powerful divine senses swept from various major sect directions, carrying wariness and questioning. One of them was particularly powerful, and Chen Ji recognized it as the aura of the old sect master of Tianqing Sect, Ling Yuan—appearing to protect, but actually harboring malicious intent.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji, do you understand what happened when the Demonic Path's aura invaded our Tianqing Sect territory?" Ling Yuan's voice, aged yet authoritative, rang in Chen Ji's mind. "If any Demonic Path villains try to contact you, report immediately. Do not harm yourself." His words carried a hidden warning, seemingly probing Chen Ji's stance.

text.content: Chen Ji coldly smiled in his heart. This old fox arrived just in time, afraid that he might collude with the Demonic Path. But Chen Ji knew clearly that Ling Yuan's covetousness toward the Tianji Record had never ceased—this concern was merely a ill-intentioned probe. His expression remained unchanged as he respectfully replied: "This disciple understands and will surely remember the sect master's teachings."

However, as various forces were secretly maneuvering against each other, the Tianji Record Fragment trembled again. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in Chen Ji's heart: "Boy, do you sense it? The Eye of Heavenly Dao is watching you. Everything just now was merely aprobing on its chessboard."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's heart tightened. He raised his head, his gaze seemingly piercing through重重 barriers, staring at that indescribable existence in the void. The air seemed to freeze at this moment, a bone-deep chill rising from his spine. The Eye of Heavenly Dao—that terrifying existence that had always used generations of prophets as chess pieces—was now fixing its gaze upon him.

text.content: "It wants to see how I will choose," Chen Ji murmured, his voice terrifyingly calm. "The Demonic Path recruits me, the Heavenly Realm rejects me—which side should I stand on? The answer is simple—neither side." A sharp gleam flickered in his eyes, that was his pride and ambition.

choice.prompt: The eyes of three forces fell upon Chen Ji simultaneously—the Demonic Commander's summons had not yet faded, the Heavenly Realm's local forces watched with predatory intent, and the Eye of Heavenly Dao observed secretly. At this critical juncture, Chen Ji had to display his true stance:

choices.description: Under the gaze of the Eye of Heavenly Dao, proactively activate the full power of the Tianji Record Fragment, demonstrating that the protagonist is not a chess piece to be manipulated at will.
choices.visible_cost: Completely exposing the existence of the Tianji Record may attract more enemies
choices.visible_reward: Establish prestige before all forces, making the Eye of Heavenly Dao regard him with new eyes
choices.risk_hint: May anger the Eye of Heavenly Dao, triggering unforeseeable consequences
choices.process_label: 陈机决定亮出底牌震慑全场

text.content: Chen Ji forcefully activated the Tianji Record Fragment. A brilliant golden light erupted from his Brow Center. That golden light contained the chaotic laws of the world's initial creation, directly tearing apart both the Demonic Path's aura shrouding the quiet chamber and the Heavenly Realm's divine senses.

The consciousness of all forces simultaneously froze. They felt the ancient and majestic nature of that power—this was not something atrash disciple should possess. Chen Ji's figure was faintly visible within the golden light, as if becoming one with heaven and earth.

choices.description: Suppressing his aura, continuing to play the role of atrash disciple, letting all forces continue to underestimate him.
choices.visible_cost: Temporarily unable to gain greater discourse power
choices.visible_reward: Maintain maximum concealment, letting the enemy continue to make mistakes
choices.risk_hint: May be seen as weak and easy to bully

text.content: The golden light flashed and vanished. Chen Ji quickly suppressed his aura, reverting to being that unremarkable outer disciple. His gaze was deep and calm, as if everything just now was merely an illusion. "Forgive me, seniors. That was merely the instinctive reaction of the Tianji Record Fragment."

The intents of various factions swept repeatedly over Chen Ji, yet could no longer detect that power. They were either suspicious or disdainful, but none could see through Chen Ji's calm features to his true thoughts.

The quiet room regained its tranquility, yet Chen Ji knew this was merely the calm before the storm. The summoning of the Demonic Path commander, Ling Yuan's probing, the gaze of the Heavenly Dao's Eye—all portended an even greater upheaval approaching. He closed his eyes, and the Tianji Record Fragment in the depths of his consciousness glowed faintly, projecting a hazy vision of the next three hours.

"Interesting." Chen Ji murmured, a faint smile playing at his lips. "Three factions extending their hands to me simultaneously saves me considerable effort." His eyes opened, filled with the brilliance of meticulous calculation. "Since that's the case, I'll accept all offers—let's see who emerges victorious in this grand game of chess."

Just then, hurried footsteps sounded outside the quiet chamber. A Tianqing Sect disciple halted before the door, respectfully announcing, "Brother Chen, Sister Su Qingyao requests an urgent meeting. Please proceed to the Inner Sect." Chen Ji's eyes flickered with interest—at last, the woman who had repeatedly probed the truth could no longer restrain herself?

dialogue.content: "I'll go right away." Chen Ji rose, adjusting his robe, while his mind raced through calculations. Su Qingyao's summons at this moment undoubtedly related to the earlier phenomenon. That cold, formidable Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, repeatedly thwarted in her attempts to uncover the truth—what could she possibly discover this time?

text.content: As he stepped out of the quiet chamber, Chen Ji cast one final glance skyward. The clouds drifted peacefully, as if nothing had transpired. Yet he understood that on a higher plane, the Eye of Heavenly Dao observed him, viewing him as another potential piece in an elaborate game of cosmic strategy. "Then let it observe closely," he silently intoned. "In this final chess match, I shall be the one who moves the pieces."
